mentions.name: AI-first synthetic API monitoring tool
mentions.description: This tool provides synthetic monitoring for APIs: it mimics users and generates continuous traffic against APIs so problems are caught before real users complain. It is AI-first, using AI to do the heavy lifting of setup, significantly simplifying configuration compared to existing tools while producing high-quality monitoring. It is in early stages and collecting feedback from potential users.
mentions.problem: Existing synthetic monitoring tools for APIs require a lot of manual work to set up.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am building a tool for synthetic monitoring for APIs. (Mimic users and generate continuous traffic against your APIs so that you catch problems before your users complain.)
